tool_schemas.name: execute_code
tool_schemas.description: Execute JavaScript or Python code securely with comprehensive error handling and security measures

enableNetworking.description: Enable network access for this execution

tool_schemas.name: execute_code_with_variables
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided JavaScript or Python source with optional stdin and per-request resource/networking settings, parsing `variables` from either an object or a JSON string and returning the execution result (e.g., stdout/stderr/output plus exit status and any runtime error details) while recording the request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `language` is not supported, `code` is missing/empty, `variables` is not valid JSON when passed as a string, or when `timeout` (>60000) / `memoryLimit` (>512) / other fields fail schema validation; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the caller is not permitted to run code or to set `enableNetworking=true`; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when execution limits are reached. Raises EXECUTION_TIMEOUT when runtime exceeds `timeout`, RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED when memory limits are hit, and EXECUTION_REJECTED when the security policy blocks the code or requested capabilities (including networking) for the active capability profile.

variables.description: Dynamic input variables as key-value pairs. Can be a JSON object or a JSON string (e.g., {"name": "John", "age": 25, "items": [1,2,3]} or "{\"name\": \"John\", \"age\": 25}")

input.description: Additional input data for the program (stdin)

enableNetworking.description: Enable network access for this execution

tool_schemas.name: get_capabilities
tool_schemas.description: Returns platform capability configuration for secure execution, either a single capability profile when `capabilityProfileId` is provided or a paged list of profiles filtered by `status` and/or `language`. List results are paginated with `limit` and an opaque `cursor`; the response includes the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid `capabilityProfileId` format, unsupported filter values, or out-of-range `limit`; raises NOT_FOUND when the requested `capabilityProfileId` does not exist; and raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the caller is not allowed to view capability profiles.

capabilityProfileId.description: Optional capability profile ULID to query; if omitted, returns the active/default platform capabilities.

status.description: Filter capability profiles by status when listing capabilities.

language.description: Filter to capability profiles that support the specified language.

limit.description: Maximum number of capability profiles to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: validate_code
tool_schemas.description: Performs a validation-only scan of JavaScript or Python source and returns validation findings (including syntax and security/policy issues) without executing the code, while recording the validation request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `language` is not supported, `code` is missing/empty, or request fields fail schema validation; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the caller is not permitted to run validations; and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when validation rate/usage limits are exceeded. Raises VALIDATION_REJECTED when the code cannot be parsed or violates mandatory security policy checks for the active capability profile.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity and entitlements derived from the presented API key, including key status, granted scopes, and current UTC-day quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses requests with missing/invalid credentials or revoked keys.

apiKey.description: API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

tool_schemas.name: list_execution_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded execution requests for the authenticated API key, optionally filtered by status/language/time range, newest-first. Returns a paginated result set and an opaque cursor for fetching the next page. Refuses requests with missing/invalid credentials.

apiKey.description: API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

fromRequestedAt.description: Only include requests with requested_at >= this timestamp (RFC 3339).

toRequestedAt.description: Only include requests with requested_at <= this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of execution requests to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_execution_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single execution request by id, including status, outputs (stdout/stderr), runtime error details, and timing fields. Refuses access if the request does not belong to the authenticated API key.

apiKey.description: API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

tool_schemas.name: cancel_execution_request
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to cancel a queued or running execution request owned by the authenticated API key. Transitions status to cancelled when permitted; refuses cancellation for terminal states and returns the current request record.

apiKey.description: API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

tool_schemas.name: list_code_validations
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded validation-only scans for the authenticated API key, optionally filtered by status/language/time range, newest-first. Returns a paginated result set and an opaque cursor for fetching the next page. Refuses requests with missing/invalid credentials.

apiKey.description: API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

fromRequestedAt.description: Only include validations with requested_at >= this timestamp (RFC 3339).

toRequestedAt.description: Only include validations with requested_at <= this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of validation records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_code_validation
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single code validation record by id, including findings/issues, syntax/security flags, and any error message. Refuses access if the record does not belong to the authenticated API key.

apiKey.description: API key presented for authentication (sent exactly as issued).

metadata.name: Code Runner
metadata.description: This backend powers a secure code-execution API for JavaScript and Python. It stores execution requests (including inputs, variables, resource limits, and networking flags), validation-only scans, and the platform capability configuration used to answer capability queries and enforce security/quota
